image: fedora:44 container (registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:44, Fedora Linux 44 x86_64) with the OpenMixer worker image's plugin set
realtime: SCHED_FIFO granted to the Job (the omx-qualify-rt namespace adds SYS_NICE and IPC_LOCK); memory locked through IPC_LOCK
jack: jackd 1.9.22, dummy driver at the set's cell (its grid), private to the pod, real-time: jackd -R -P 70, measure.sh refuses a base none of whose threads is SCHED_FIFO

settings.note: the directories scanned are plugin-hostd's: clap_path /usr/lib64/clap:/usr/lib/clap in a plugin-hostd.conf of the base, named by hostd_conf. measured with host_class x86_64 in the settings file; the class is a directory name only and no record holds it, so the set is published as x86-64, a name the Debian and RPM package names both accept
